#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline SIP identity boundary auditor (Boundary Profile 1).

Reads one JSON document on stdin, writes one JSON document on stdout.
Never opens a socket; standard library only.
"""

import sys
import json
import re
import hashlib
from collections import deque

MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 33554432
MAX_TOTAL_WIRE = 8388608
MAX_EVENTS = 10000
MAX_HEXLEN = 131072
MAX_T = 9007199254740991

ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"

REQ_BODY_MAX = 65536
HDR_BLOCK_MAX = 32768
LINE_MAX = 8192
HDR_LINES_MAX = 256

_ALPHA = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
_DIGITS = "0123456789"
_UNRESERVED = frozenset(_ALPHA + _DIGITS + "-_.!~*'()")
_TOKEN = frozenset(_ALPHA + _DIGITS + "-.!%*_+`'~")
_HEXCH = frozenset(_DIGITS + "abcdefABCDEF")
_TELSEP = frozenset("-.()")
_OWS = " \t"
_STOP = frozenset(';,<> \t"')

_TOKCLASS = r"[A-Za-z0-9\-\.!%*_+`'~]"
ID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}")
_LABEL = r"[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9\-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?"
HOST_RE = re.compile(_LABEL + r"(?:\." + _LABEL + r")+")
PORT_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}")
NAME_RE = re.compile(_TOKCLASS + r"+")
DN_RE = re.compile(_TOKCLASS + r"+(?:[ \t]+" + _TOKCLASS + r"+)*")
CL_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,10}")
CALLID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9\-_.@]{1,64}")
HEXSTR_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]*")
HDRBYTES_RE = re.compile(rb"[\x09\x20-\x7e]*")

COMPACT = {"f": "from", "t": "to", "i": "call-id", "l": "content-length"}
SINGLETONS = ("from", "to", "call-id", "content-length", "cseq")


class BadEnvelope(Exception):
    pass


class Reject(Exception):
    __slots__ = ("reason",)

    def __init__(self, reason):
        Exception.__init__(self, reason)
        self.reason = reason


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# URI canonicalization (section 2)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _decode_user(u):
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(u)
    while i < n:
        c = u[i]
        if c == "%":
            if i + 3 > n:
                return None
            h1 = u[i + 1]
            h2 = u[i + 2]
            if h1 not in _HEXCH or h2 not in _HEXCH:
                return None
            ch = chr(int(h1 + h2, 16))
            if ch not in _UNRESERVED:
                return None
            out.append(ch)
            i += 3
            continue
        if c in _UNRESERVED:
            out.append(c)
            i += 1
            continue
        return None
    return "".join(out)


def canon_sip(s):
    n = len(s)
    if n < 5:
        return None
    head = s[:5].lower()
    if head.startswith("sips:"):
        scheme = "sips"
        rest = s[5:]
    elif head.startswith("sip:"):
        scheme = "sip"
        rest = s[4:]
    else:
        return None
    at = rest.find("@")
    if at < 0:
        return None
    hostport = rest[at + 1:]
    if "@" in hostport:
        return None
    user = _decode_user(rest[:at])
    if user is None:
        return None
    ulen = len(user)
    if ulen < 1 or ulen > 64:
        return None
    colon = hostport.find(":")
